subject: general
question: Which of the following wetlands is located in Kerala?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sasthamkotta Lake.**__

__
 
• There are three wetlands in Kerala:
 
 
• Ashtamudi Wetland
 
• **Sasthamkotta lake**
 
• Vembanad Kol Wetland

• Wetlands are also called sponges of earth.
 
• Wetlands absorb water from floods.
 
• The biodiversity is found near wetlands.
 
• World Wetland Day: 2 February.
